mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_VOLCANO_* from Data/Player/HDK_PantMale04.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:222-228; no helm). MU's number 32. Ours is *Male33 by the index-plus-one rule; MU never loads a *Male33 file.
why_this_one: The Magic Gladiator's level-380 set, Kanturu's gear (the user, 2026-10-22: 'lets now cook kanturu weapons and armors', dormant until Kanturu drops them).

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (Season 2's level-380 sets; 0.75 and 0.95d have none).
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Drops in Kanturu only (the user, 2026-10-25: "The 380 gear", "Kanturu only"): sim::kanturuGear keeps anything asking level 380 to the maps whose rules drop kanturu_gear. Its drop level is MU's.
stats.requires_note: MU asks level 380 (OpenMU's levelRequirement), and so does ours (the user, 2026-10-25: "Level 380"): found in the Ruins from 320, worn from 380. The stat columns are raw, scaled by the drop level as every item's.
stats.class_level_note: The Magic Gladiator's alone: OpenMU's magicGladiatorClassLevel 1, his only class. No helm: his sets go bare-headed (MuMain loads no HDK_HelmMale 4).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player hoblinset_*.OZJ, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: grey steel plate with gold scrollwork, copper straps and black mail. hoblinset_head.OZJ is not decoded: there is no helm.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain, the gold and the shading painted on, as every second set here.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_VOLCANO_* (no glow, no chrome pass). Its +10 boots' violet (0.5, 0.24, 0.8) set aura (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11004-11030) is not built: fx/set_shine has no 380 sets yet.
